2. The 'Land of the Long White Cloud' is New Zealand.
3. The 'Paradise on Earth' in the subcontinent is Rajasthan.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 1, 2.

q.q: Which of the following is NOT a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Pakistan?
q.e: Badshahi Mosque is not a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Pakistan.

q.q: Which of the following is NOT a country crossed by the Tropic of Capricorn?
q.e: Zambia is not a country crossed by the Tropic of Capricorn.

q.q: The river Vltava flows through the city of:
q.e: The river Vltava flows through the city of Prague.

q.q: Mount Erebus is the southernmost active volcano, located in:
q.e: Mount Erebus is the southernmost active volcano, located in Antarctica.

q.q: The capital of Jordan is:
q.e: The capital of Jordan is Amman.

q.q: The Sonoran Desert lies in the United States and:
q.e: The Sonoran Desert lies in the United States and Mexico.

q.q: Which of the following is NOT a landlocked country?
q.e: Ukraine is not a landlocked country.

q.q: The lake or waterfall shared by or located in Kazakhstan is:
q.e: The lake or waterfall shared by or located in Kazakhstan is Lake Balkhash.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The largest rainforest in the world is the Amazon Rainforest.
2. The largest mangrove forest in the world is the Amazon Rainforest.
3. The country with the largest number of islands is Sweden.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 1, 3.

q.q: Three cards are drawn at random without replacement from a well-shuffled pack of 52 cards. The probability that at least one of them is an ace is:
How many digits does 2^100 have?
q.e: Digits = ⌊100 log 2⌋ + 1 = 31.

q.q: Two trains 100 m and 300 m long run at 36 km/h and 108 km/h. If they move in the same direction on parallel tracks, how long (in seconds) does the faster take to completely overtake the slower?
q.e: Relative speed = 72 km/h = 20 m/s; time = 400/20 = 20 s.

q.q: Two travellers start at the same time from towns P and Q towards each other. After meeting, the first reaches Q in 36 hours and the second reaches P in 100 hours. After how many hours from the start did they meet?
q.e: Time to meet = √(36×100) = 60 hours.

q.q: In base 7, the value of (166) + (550) is:
q.e: Convert to decimal, add, and convert back to base 7: 1046.

q.q: What is the remainder when 2^250 is divided by 11?
q.e: Use the cycle of 2^k mod 11: 2^250 ≡ 1.

q.q: In an arithmetic progression the 5th term is 10 and the 4th term is 8. The sum of its first 18 terms is:

In a group, 38 students like cricket, 53 like football and 37 like hockey; 13 like cricket and football, 9 like football and hockey, 9 like hockey and cricket, and 7 like all three games. Every student likes at least one game. How many students like exactly two of the games?
q.e: Exactly two = Σpairs − 3·(all three) = 31 − 21 = 10.

q.q: A boat's speed in still water is 8 km/h and the stream flows at 4 km/h. It goes a certain distance downstream and returns to the starting point in 12 hours. What is that one-way distance (km)?
The smallest number which leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by 4, 12 and 6, and is exactly divisible by 11, is:
q.e: x = 12m + 1; choose the least m with x divisible by 11: 121.

q.q:
The table gives the production (in thousand tonnes) of three crops.
Crop | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022
Wheat | 130 | 150 | 160 | 40
Rice | 50 | 190 | 90 | 160
Maize | 140 | 150 | 120 | 170
The ratio of the total production of all three crops in 2019 to that in 2022 is:
In how many ways can the letters of the word LEADING be arranged so that all the vowels come together?
q.e: Treat the vowels as a block / gap method: 720.

q.q: If sin θ = 5/13 and θ is acute, the value of 3 tan θ − 2 cos θ is:
The point which divides the line segment joining A(3, 8) and B(8, -3) internally in the ratio 1:2 is:
q.e: Section formula: (1x₂+2x₁)/(1+2), (1y₂+2y₁)/(1+2).

q.q: In a certain code, PACK is written as 180 and FIRM is written as 82. How will CAMEL be written in that code?
q.e: The code is the alphabet position of the first letter times that of the last, plus the number of letters; CAMEL → 41.

q.q: 5 people sit in a row from left to right. Each has a different drink (coffee, juice, milk, tea, water) and a different job (banker, doctor, farmer, pilot, teacher). The person with drink juice sits immediately to the left of the person with job teacher. The person with drink coffee sits at the right end. The person with drink coffee does not have job pilot. The person with drink water does not have job doctor. The person with drink milk does not have job farmer. The person whose drink is tea has job farmer. The person with drink water sits immediately to the left of the person with job farmer. The person whose drink is water has job pilot. The person whose drink is juice has job banker. The person whose drink is coffee has job teacher. The person with drink juice sits next to the person with job farmer. Which job belongs to the person with drink juice?
q.e: Place the fixed-position clues first, then combine the matching clues; only one arrangement satisfies them all.

q.q: A courier starts from a point and goes 8 m towards the north, then turns left and goes 5 m, then turns left and goes 8 m, then turns left and goes 9 m. How far, and in which direction, is he now from the starting point?
o: 4 m east of the starting point
6 m east of the starting point
4 m south-west of the starting point
4 m north-east of the starting point
q.e: Coordinates of the end point (E,N) = (4, 0); distance = √(4²+0²) = 4 m, direction east.

q.q: 6 students Ali, Ayesha, Bilal, Omar, Sadia, Salman each have a test on a different day, from Monday to Saturday (one test per day). Sadia's test is held earlier in the week than Salman's. Omar's test is held on a day between those of Ayesha and Bilal. Exactly 2 days separate Sadia's test and Bilal's. Salman's and Ali's tests are not on consecutive days. Bilal's and Ali's tests are on consecutive days. Ali's test is held earlier in the week than Salman's. Bilal's test is on either the first or the last day. Salman's test is held on the day immediately before Ayesha's. On which day is Sadia's test held?
q.e: Place the definite clues first (immediate neighbours, ends), then use the 'between' and 'left of' clues to fix the rest; the arrangement is unique.

q.q: How many leap years are there from 1947 to 2247 (both inclusive)?
q.e: Divisible by 4 minus centuries not divisible by 400: 73.

q.q: The time shown in a mirror is 11:10. What is the actual time?
What comes next? AB, CD, EF, GH, ?
q.e: First letter moves +2 and the second stays 1 places ahead of it.

q.q: Which of the following numbers does not belong with the others?  89, 34, 19, 233, 13
q.e: Four of them are Fibonacci numbers; 19 is not.

q.q: On an island every inhabitant is either a knight (always tells the truth) or a knave (always lies). Waqar says: "Mehwish and Faraz are of different types." Mehwish says: "Faraz is a knave." Salman says: "Exactly 1 of the 4 of us is a knight." Faraz says: "Exactly 2 of the 4 of us are knights." What is Waqar?
o: both a knight and a knave
q.e: Only one knight/knave assignment is consistent with all the statements.

q.q: Statement: X > P = V ≥ Y > U. Conclusions: I. P ≤ Y  II. Y = V  III. U > P. Which of the conclusions is/are definitely true?
o: Only I and II are true
q.e: A conclusion is definitely true only if it holds for every set of values consistent with the whole chain.

q.q: Ayesha is the daughter of Salman. Salman is the husband of Mehwish. Mehwish is the sister of Rabia. Rabia is the daughter of Shazia. Shazia is the mother of Anwar. How is Ayesha related to Anwar?
q.e: Work through the chain link by link, assuming the usual convention that a couple's children are common to both.

q.q:
Find the missing number in the third row:
6  7  36
5  6  25
2  3  ?
q.e: The rule is c = a × b − a, so the missing number is 4.

q.q: The top-level domain of India is:
q.e: The top-level domain of India is .in.

q.e: The neural network architecture suited for sequential data with memory cells (LSTM) is the RNN.

q.e: The algorithm that finds the shortest path in a weighted graph with non-negative weights is Dijkstra's.

q.q: The decimal equivalent of the binary number 1001110 is:
The number of rows in the truth table of a Boolean function of 4 variables is:
The shortcut key for "Save As" in Microsoft Office is:

q.e: The full form of SRAM is Static Random Access Memory.

q.e: Linux is an operating system.
